description: [Merchant] Export a READY report in a specific format (PDF, CSV, Excel, JSON). The report must be in READY status first.

partnerId.description: Partner ID from payware dashboard. Uses PAYWARE_PARTNER_ID env var as default.

privateKey.description: RSA private key for authentication. Uses production private key as default (Data API is production-only).

requestId.description: The request ID from the report generation (UUID format)

name: payware_data_export_report
